using System;

namespace ArrayRotation
{
    public class Program
    {
        // Function to left rotate the array by one
        public static void LeftRotateByOne(int[] arr, int n)
        {
            int temp = arr[0];
            for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; i++)
            {
                arr[i] = arr[i + 1];
            }
            arr[n - 1] = temp;
        }

        // Function to left rotate the array by d positions
        public static void LeftRotate(int[] arr, int d, int n)
        {
            for (int i = 0; i < d; i++)
            {
                LeftRotateByOne(arr, n);
            }
        }

        // Function to print the array
        public static void PrintArray(int[] arr, int n)
        {
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)

                Console.Write(arr[i] + " ");
            }
        }

        static void Main()
        {

```csharp
using System;

class Program
{
    // Method to find the first missing element in a sorted array
    static int FindFirstMissing(int[] array, int start, int end)
    {
        if (start > end)
            return end + 1;

        if (start != array[start])
            return start;

        int mid = (start + end) / 2;

        if (array[mid] == mid)
            return FindFirstMissing(array, mid + 1, end);

        return FindFirstMissing(array, start, mid);
    }

    static void Main()
    {
        int[] arr = new int[] { 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 10 };
        int n = arr.Length;

        Console.WriteLine("Smallest missing element is {0}", FindFirstMissing(arr, 0, n - 1));
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System;

class Program
{
```
```csharp
    static bool IsMajority(int[] arr, int n, int x)
    {
        int lastIndex = n % 2 == 1 ? (n / 2 + 1) : (n / 2);
        for (int i = 0; i < lastIndex; i++)
        {
            if (arr[i] == x && arr[i + n / 2] == x)
                return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    static void Main()
    {
        int[] arr = { 1, 2, 3, 4, 4, 4, 4 };
        int n = arr.Length;
        int x = 4;
        if (IsMajority(arr, n, x))
            Console.WriteLine($"{x} appears more than {n / 2} times in arr[]");
        else
            Console.WriteLine($"{x} does not appear more than {n / 2} times in arr[]");
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System;

class Program
{
    static bool IsMajority(int[] arr, int n, int x)
    {
        int lastIndex = n % 2 == 1 ? (n / 2 + 1) : (n / 2);
        for (int i = 0; i < lastIndex; i++)
        {
            if (arr[i] == x && arr[i + n / 2] == x)
                return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    static void Main()
    {
        int[] arr = { 1, 2, 3, 4, 4, 4, 4 };
        int n = arr.Length;
```

```csharp
    {
```
```csharp
        if (high >= low)

            if ((mid == 0 || x > arr[mid - 1]) && arr[mid] == x)
```

```csharp
using System;
```
```csharp
using System.Linq;

public class RodCutting
{
    static int Max(int a, int b)
    {
        return (a > b) ? a : b;
    }

    static int CutRod(int[] price, int n)
    {
        int[] val = new int[n + 1];
        val[0] = 0;
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++)
        {
            int max_val = int.MinValue;
            for (int j = 0; j < i; j++)
            {
                max_val = Max(max_val, price[j] + val[i - j - 1]);
            }
            val[i] = max_val;
        }
        return val[n];
    }

    static void Main()
    {
        int[] arr = new int[] { 1, 5, 8, 9, 10, 17, 17, 20 };
        int size = arr.Length;
        Console.WriteLine("Maximum Obtainable Value is {0}", CutRod(arr, size));
        Console.ReadKey();
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System;
using System.Linq;

public class RodCutting
{
    static int Max(int a, int b)
    {
        return (a > b) ? a : b;
    }

    static int CutRod(int[] price, int n)
    {
        int[] val = new int[n + 1];
        val[0] = 0;

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++)
        {
            int max_val = int.MinValue;
            for (int j = 0; j < i; j++)
            {
                max_val = Max(max_val, price[j] + val[i - j - 1]);
            }
            val[i] = max_val;
        }
        return val[n];
    }

    static void Main()
    {
        int[] arr = new int[] { 1, 5, 8, 9, 10, 17, 17, 20 };
        int size = arr.Length;
```
```csharp
        Console.WriteLine("Maximum Obtainable Value is " + CutRod(arr, size));
        Console.ReadKey();
    }
}
```

```c
#include <stdio.h>
```
```c
#include <stdlib.h>

int compare(const void *a, const void *b) {
    return (*(int*)a - *(int*)b);
}

int areElementsContiguous(int* arr, int n) {
    qsort(arr, n, sizeof(int), compare);
    for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
        if (arr[i] - arr[i - 1] > 1) {
            return 0; // false
        }
    }
    return 1; // true
}

int main() {
    int arr[] = {5, 2, 3, 6, 4, 4, 6, 6};
    int n = sizeof(arr) / sizeof(arr[0]);
    if (areElementsContiguous(arr, n)) {
        printf("Yes\n");
    } else {
        printf("No\n");
    }
    return 0;
}
```

#include <stdio.h>

```c
// Function to left rotate the array by one
void leftRotatebyOne(int arr[], int n) {
    int i, temp = arr[0];
    for (i = 0; i < n - 1; i++)
        arr[i] = arr[i + 1];
    arr[n - 1] = temp;
}

// Function to left rotate the array by d positions
void leftRotate(int arr[], int d, int n) {
    for (int i = 0; i < d; i++)
        leftRotatebyOne(arr, n);
}

// Function to print the array
```

#include <stdio.h>

```c
// Function to find the first missing element
int findFirstMissing(int array[], int start, int end) {
    // If start index is greater than end index, return the next element
    if (start > end) return end + 1;
    // If the start index does not match the value at that index, return start
    if (start != array[start]) return start;
    
    int mid = (start + end) / 2; // Calculate mid index
    // If the value at mid index matches mid, search in the right half
    if (array[mid] == mid) return findFirstMissing(array, mid + 1, end);
    
    // Otherwise, search in the left half
    return findFirstMissing(array, start, mid);
}

int main() {
    // Array of integers
    int arr[] = {0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 10};
    // Calculate the number of elements in the array
    int n = sizeof(arr) / sizeof(arr[0]);
    // Output the result
    printf("Smallest Missing element is: %d\n", findFirstMissing(arr, 0, n - 1));
    return 0;
}
```

```c
int FindMaxSum(int* arr, int n) {
    int incl = arr[0];

    int excl_new;
    int i;

        excl = excl_new;
```

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>

```c
int binarySearch(int* arr, int low, int high, int x) {
    if (high >= low) {
        int mid = (low + high) / 2;
        if ((mid == 0 || x > arr[mid - 1]) && (arr[mid] == x)) 
            return mid;
        else if (x > arr[mid]) 
            return binarySearch(arr, mid + 1, high, x);
        else 
            return binarySearch(arr, low, mid - 1, x);
    }
    return -1;
}

int isMajority(int* arr, int n, int x) {
    int i = binarySearch(arr, 0, n - 1, x);
    if (i == -1) 
        return 0; // false
    if ((i + n / 2) <= (n - 1) && arr[i + n / 2] == x) 
        return 1; // true
    else 
        return 0; // false
}

int main() {
    int* arr = (int*)malloc(7 * sizeof(int));
    if (arr == NULL) {
        printf("Memory allocation failed\n");
        return 1; // Error handling for memory allocation
    }
    
    arr[0] = 1;
    arr[1] = 2;
    arr[2] = 3;

    arr[4] = 3;

        printf("%d appears more than %d times in arr[]\n", x, n / 2);
    else 
        printf("%d does not appear more than %d times in arr[]\n", x, n / 2);
```

#include <stdio.h>
```c
#include <limits.h>

int cutRod(int price[], int n) {
    int val[n + 1];
    val[0] = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        int max_val = -2147483648;
        for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) {
            if (max_val < price[j] + val[i - j - 1]) {
                max_val = price[j] + val[i - j - 1];
            }
        }
        val[i] = max_val;
    }
    return val[n];
}

int main() {
    int arr[] = {1, 5, 8, 9, 10, 17, 17, 20};
    int size = sizeof(arr) / sizeof(arr[0]);
    printf("Maximum Obtainable Value is %d\n", cutRod(arr, size));
    return 0;
}
```

```javascript
    if (start > end) return end + 1;
```

```javascript
function binarySearch(arr, low, high, x) {
    if (high >= low) {
        let mid = Math.floor((low + high) / 2);
        if ((mid === 0 || x > arr[mid - 1]) && arr[mid] === x) {
            return mid;
        } else if (x > arr[mid]) {
            return binarySearch(arr, mid + 1, high, x);
        } else {
            return binarySearch(arr, low, mid - 1, x);
        }
    }
    return -1;
}

function isMajority(arr, n, x) {
    let i = binarySearch(arr, 0, n - 1, x);
    if (i === -1) return false;
    if ((i + Math.floor(n / 2) <= n - 1) && arr[i + Math.floor(n / 2)] === x) {
        return true;
    } else {
        return false;
    }
}
```

```javascript
    let val = new Array(n + 1);
    val[0] = 0;
    for (let i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        let max_val = Number.MIN_SAFE_INTEGER;
        for (let j = 0; j < i; j++) {
```

```c
#include <stdio.h>
```

```c
int _binarySearch(int *arr, size_t low, size_t high, int x) {
    if (high >= low) {
        size_t mid = (low + high) / 2;
        if ((mid == 0 || x > arr[mid - 1]) && arr[mid] == x) {
            return mid;
        } else if (x > arr[mid]) {
            return _binarySearch(arr, mid + 1, high, x);
        } else {
            return _binarySearch(arr, low, mid - 1, x);
        }
    }
    return -1;
}

int isMajority(int *arr, size_t n, int x) {
    int i = _binarySearch(arr, 0, n - 1, x);
    if (i == -1) return 0; // false
    if ((i + n / 2 <= n - 1) && arr[i + n / 2] == x) {
        return 1; // true
    } else {
        return 0; // false
    }
}

int main() {
    int arr[] = {1, 2, 3, 3, 3, 3, 10};
    size_t n = sizeof(arr) / sizeof(arr[0]);
```

```c
int compare(const void *a, const void *b) {
    return (*(int *)a - *(int *)b);
}

int areElementsContiguous(int arr[], int n) {
    for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
        if (arr[i] - arr[i - 1] > 1) {
            return 0;
        }
    }
    return 1;
}

int main() {
    int arr[] = {5, 2, 3, 6, 4, 4, 6, 6};
    int n = sizeof(arr) / sizeof(arr[0]);
```

```c
void leftRotatebyOne(int *arr, int n) {

        arr[i] = arr[i + 1];
```

```c
#include <stdio.h>
```
```c
#include <math.h>

// Function to check if x appears more than n/2 times in arr
int isMajority(int* arr, int n, int x) {
    int i;
    int last_index = (n % 2) ? (n / 2 + 1) : (n / 2);
    
    for (i = 0; i < last_index; i++) {
        if (arr[i] == x && arr[i + n / 2] == x) {
            return 1; // x is a majority element
        }
    }
    return 0; // x is not a majority element
}

int main() {
    int arr[] = {1, 2, 3, 4, 4, 4, 4};
    int n = sizeof(arr) / sizeof(arr[0]); // Calculate the number of elements in arr
    int x = 4;

    if (isMajority(arr, n, x)) {
        printf("%d appears more than %d times in arr[]\n", x, (int)floor(n / 2));
    } else {
        printf("%d does not appear more than %d times in arr[]\n", x, (int)floor(n / 2));
    }

    return 0;
}
```

```csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;

class Program
{
    static int MinSum(int[] A, int N)
    {
        Dictionary<int, int> mp = new Dictionary<int, int>();
        int sum = 0;

        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++)
        {
            sum += A[i];
            if (mp.ContainsKey(A[i])) mp[A[i]]++;
            else mp[A[i]] = 1;
        }

        int minSum = int.MaxValue;

        foreach (var it in mp)
        {
            minSum = Math.Min(minSum, sum - (it.Key * it.Value));
        }

        return minSum;
    }

    static void Main()
    {
        int[] arr = { 4, 5, 6, 6 };
        int N = arr.Length;
        Console.WriteLine(MinSum(arr, N));
    }
```
```csharp
}

    static void MaxAdjacent(int[] arr, int N)
    {
        if (N < 3) return; // Error handling for edge cases
        List<int> res = new List<int>();
        for (int i = 1; i < N - 1; i++)
        {

                prev = arr[j];

            res.Add(maxi);
        }

        Console.WriteLine();
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System;
```

```csharp
public class Program
{
    public static int FindSize(int N)
    {
        if (N == 0) return 1;
        if (N == 1) return 1;
        int size = 2 * FindSize(N / 2) + 1;
        return size;
    }

    public static int CountOnes(int N, int L, int R)
    {
        if (L > R)
        {
            return 0;
        }
        if (N <= 1)
        {
            return N;
        }
        int ret = 0;
        int M = N / 2;
        int Siz_M = FindSize(M);
        if (L <= Siz_M)
        {
            ret += CountOnes(N / 2, L, Math.Min(Siz_M, R));
        }
        if (L <= Siz_M + 1 && Siz_M + 1 <= R)
        {
            ret += N % 2;
        }
        if (Siz_M + 1 < R)
        {
            ret += CountOnes(N / 2, Math.Max(1, L - Siz_M - 1), R - Siz_M - 1);
        }
        return ret;
    }

    public static void Main()
    {
        int N = 7, L = 2, R = 5;
        Console.WriteLine(CountOnes(N, L, R));
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System;
```
```csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;

public class Program
{
    static int Landau = int.MinValue;

    static int GCD(int a, int b)
    {
        if (a == 0) return b;
        return GCD(b % a, a);
    }

    static int LCM(int a, int b)
    {
        return (a * b) / GCD(a, b);
    }

    static void FindLCM(List<int> arr)
    {
        int nth_lcm = arr[0];
        for (int i = 1; i < arr.Count; i++)
            nth_lcm = LCM(nth_lcm, arr[i]);
        Landau = Math.Max(Landau, nth_lcm);
    }

    static void FindWays(List<int> arr, int i, int n)
    {
        if (n == 0) FindLCM(arr);
        for (int j = i; j <= n; j++)
        {
            arr.Add(j);
            FindWays(arr, j, n - j);
            arr.RemoveAt(arr.Count - 1);
        }
    }

    static void LandauFunction(int n)
    {
        List<int> arr = new List<int>();
        FindWays(arr, 1, n);
        Console.WriteLine(Landau);
    }

    static void Main()
    {
        int N = 4;
        LandauFunction(N);
    }
}
```

```cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <limits>
#include <algorithm>

class GFG {
public:
    static int minSum(std::vector<int>& A, int N) {
        std::unordered_map<int, int> mp;
        int sum = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            sum += A[i];
            if (mp.find(A[i]) != mp.end()) {
                mp[A[i]]++;
            } else {
                mp[A[i]] = 1;
            }
        }
        int minSum = std::numeric_limits<int>::max();
        for (const auto& it : mp) {
            minSum = std::min(minSum, sum - (it.first * it.second));
        }
        return minSum;
    }
};

int main() {
    std::vector<int> arr = {4, 5, 6, 6};
    int N = arr.size();
    std::cout << GFG::minSum(arr, N) << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
```

```cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
```
```cpp
#include <limits>

class GFG {
public:
```
```cpp
    static int Landau;

    static int gcd(int a, int b) {
        if (a == 0) return b;
        return gcd(b % a, a);
    }

    static int lcm(int a, int b) {
        return (a * b) / gcd(a, b);
    }

    static void findLCM(std::vector<int>& arr) {
        int nth_lcm = arr[0];
        for (size_t i = 1; i < arr.size(); i++)
            nth_lcm = lcm(nth_lcm, arr[i]);
        Landau = std::max(Landau, nth_lcm);
    }

    static void findWays(std::vector<int>& arr, int i, int n) {
        if (n == 0) findLCM(arr);
        for (int j = i; j <= n; j++) {
            arr.push_back(j);
            findWays(arr, j, n - j);
            arr.pop_back();
        }
    }

    static void Landau_function(int n) {
        std::vector<int> arr;
        findWays(arr, 1, n);
        std::cout << Landau;
    }
};

int GFG::Landau = std::numeric_limits<int>::min();

int main() {
    int N = 4;
    GFG::Landau_function(N);
    return 0;
}
```

```cpp
        std::vector<double> freq(100005, 0.0);

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {

            freq[temp]++;
            maxx = std::max(maxx, temp);
```

```python
from collections import Counter

def minSum(A):
    sum = 0
    for i in range(len(A)):
        sum += A[i]
    mp = Counter(A)
    minSum = float('inf')
    for key, value in mp.items():
        minSum = min(minSum, sum - (key * value))
    return minSum

if __name__ == "__main__":

    print(minSum(arr))
```

```python
import math
```
```python
from typing import List

Landau = float('-inf')

def gcd(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return b if a == 0 else gcd(b % a, a)

def lcm(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return (a * b) // gcd(a, b)

def find_lcm(arr: List[int]) -> None:
    global Landau
    nth_lcm = arr[0]
    for i in range(1, len(arr)):
        nth_lcm = lcm(nth_lcm, arr[i])
    Landau = max(Landau, nth_lcm)

def find_ways(arr: List[int], i: int, n: int) -> None:
    if n == 0:
        find_lcm(arr)
    for j in range(i, n + 1):
        arr.append(j)
        find_ways(arr, j, n - j)
        arr.pop()

def landau_function(n: int) -> None:
    arr = []
    find_ways(arr, 1, n)
    print(Landau)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    N = 4
    landau_function(N)
```

```cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <limits>
#include <algorithm>

int minSum(std::vector<int>& A, int N) {
    std::unordered_map<int, int> mp;
    int sum = 0;
    
    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
        sum += A[i];
        if (mp.find(A[i]) != mp.end()) {
            mp[A[i]]++;
        } else {
            mp[A[i]] = 1;
        }
    }
```

```cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
```
```cpp
#include <limits>
```

```cpp
long long Landau = -std::numeric_limits<long long>::max() - 1;

long long gcd(long long a, long long b) {
    if (a == 0) {
        return b;
    }
    return gcd(b % a, a);
}

long long lcm(long long a, long long b) {
    return (a * b) / gcd(a, b);
}

void findLCM(const std::vector<long long>& arr) {
    global Landau;
    long long nth_lcm = arr[0];
    for (size_t i = 1; i < arr.size(); i++) {
        nth_lcm = lcm(nth_lcm, arr[i]);
    }
    Landau = std::max(Landau, nth_lcm);
}

void findWays(std::vector<long long>& arr, long long i, long long n) {
    if (n == 0) {
        findLCM(arr);
    }
    for (long long j = i; j <= n; j++) {
        arr.push_back(j);
        findWays(arr, j, n - j);
        arr.pop_back();
    }
}

void Landau_function(long long n) {
    std::vector<long long> arr;
    findWays(arr, 1, n);
    std::cout << Landau << std::endl;
}

int main() {
    long long N = 4;
    Landau_function(N);
    return 0;
}
```

```php
class GFG {
    public static int $MAXN = 1000001;
    public static array $spf = [];
    public static array $hash1 = [];

    public static function sieve() {
        self::$spf[1] = 1;
        for ($i = 2; $i < self::$MAXN; $i++) {
            self::$spf[$i] = $i;
        }
        for ($i = 4; $i < self::$MAXN; $i += 2) {
            self::$spf[$i] = 2;
        }
        for ($i = 3; $i * $i < self::$MAXN; $i++) {
            if (self::$spf[$i] == $i) {
                for ($j = $i * $i; $j < self::$MAXN; $j += $i) {
                    if (self::$spf[$j] == $j) {
                        self::$spf[$j] = $i;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static function getFactorization($x) {
        while ($x != 1) {
            $temp = self::$spf[$x];
            if ($x % $temp == 0) {
                self::$hash1[$temp]++;
                $x = $x / $temp;
            }
            while ($x % $temp == 0) {
                $x = $x / $temp;
            }
        }
    }

    public static function check($x) {
        while ($x != 1) {
            $temp = self::$spf[$x];
            if ($x % $temp == 0 && self::$hash1[$temp] > 1) {
                return false;
            }
            while ($x % $temp == 0) {
                $x = $x / $temp;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }

    public static function hasValidNum($arr, $n) {
        self::sieve();
        for ($i = 0; $i < $n; $i++) {
            self::getFactorization($arr[$i]);
        }
        for ($i = 0; $i < $n; $i++) {
            if (self::check($arr[$i])) {
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    public static function main() {
        $arr = [2, 8, 4, 10, 6, 7];
        $n = count($arr);
        if (self::hasValidNum($arr, $n)) {
            echo "Yes\n";
        } else {
            echo "No\n";
        }
    }
}
```

                    if (self::$spf[$j] == $j) {
                        self::$spf[$j] = $i;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static function getFactorization($x) {
        while ($x != 1) {
            $temp = self::$spf[$x];
            if ($x % $temp == 0) {
                self::$hash1[$temp]++;
                $x = $x / $temp;
            }
            while ($x % $temp == 0) {
                $x = $x / $temp;
            }
        }
    }

    public static function check($x) {
        while ($x != 1) {
            $temp = self::$spf[$x];
            if ($x % $temp == 0 && self::$hash1[$temp] > 1) {
                return false;
            }
            while ($x % $temp == 0) {
                $x = $x / $temp;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }

    public static function hasValidNum($arr, $n) {
        self::sieve();
        for ($i = 0; $i < $n; $i++) {
            self::getFactorization($arr[$i]);
        }
        for ($i = 0; $i < $n; $i++) {
            if (self::check($arr[$i])) {
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    public static function main() {
        $arr = [2, 8, 4, 10, 6, 7];
        $n = count($arr);
        if (self::hasValidNum($arr, $n)) {
            echo "Yes\n";
        } else {
            echo "No\n";
        }
    }
}

```java
import java.util.Arrays;

public class PrimeFactorization {
    static final int MAXN = 10001;
    static int[] spf = new int[MAXN];
    static int[] hash1 = new int[MAXN];

    static void sieve() {
        spf[1] = 1;
        for (int i = 2; i < MAXN; i++) {
            spf[i] = i;
        }
        for (int i = 4; i < MAXN; i += 2) {
            spf[i] = 2;
        }
        for (int i = 3; i * i < MAXN; i++) {
            if (spf[i] == i) {
                for (int j = i * i; j < MAXN; j += i) {
                    if (spf[j] == j) {
                        spf[j] = i;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void getFactorization(int x) {
        while (x != 1) {
            int temp = spf[x];
            if (x % temp == 0) {
                hash1[temp]++;
                x /= temp;
            }
            while (x % temp == 0) {
                x /= temp;
            }
        }
    }

    static boolean check(int x) {
        while (x != 1) {
            int temp = spf[x];
            if (x % temp == 0 && hash1[temp] > 1) {
                return false;
            }
            while (x % temp == 0) {
                x /= temp;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }

    static boolean hasValidNum(int[] arr, int n) {
        sieve();
        Arrays.fill(hash1, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            getFactorization(arr[i]);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (check(arr[i])) {
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        int[] arr = {2, 8, 4, 10, 6, 7};
        int n = arr.length;
        if (hasValidNum(arr, n)) {
            System.out.println("Yes");
        } else {
            System.out.println("No");
        }
    }
}
```

import java.util.Arrays;

public class PrimeFactorization {
    static final int MAXN = 10001;
    static int[] spf = new int[MAXN];
    static int[] hash1 = new int[MAXN];

    static void sieve() {
        spf[1] = 1;
        for (int i = 2; i < MAXN; i++) {
            spf[i] = i;
        }
        for (int i = 4; i < MAXN; i += 2) {
            spf[i] = 2;
        }
        for (int i = 3; i * i < MAXN; i++) {
            if (spf[i] == i) {
                for (int j = i * i; j < MAXN; j += i) {
                    if (spf[j] == j) {
                        spf[j] = i;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void getFactorization(int x) {
        while (x != 1) {
            int temp = spf[x];
            if (x % temp == 0) {
                hash1[temp]++;
                x /= temp;
            }
            while (x % temp == 0) {
                x /= temp;
            }
        }
    }

    static boolean check(int x) {
        while (x != 1) {
            int temp = spf[x];
            if (x % temp == 0 && hash1[temp] > 1) {
                return false;
            }
            while (x % temp == 0) {
                x /= temp;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }

    static boolean hasValidNum(int[] arr, int n) {
        sieve();
        Arrays.fill(hash1, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            getFactorization(arr[i]);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (check(arr[i])) {
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        int[] arr = {2, 8, 4, 10, 6, 7};
        int n = arr.length;
        if (hasValidNum(arr, n)) {
            System.out.println("Yes");
        } else {
            System.out.println("No");
        }
    }
}

```java
public class Main {
```
```java
    public static boolean check(int s) {
        int[] freq = new int[10];
        while (s != 0) {
            int r = s % 10;
            s /= 10;
            freq[r]++;
        }
        int xor = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
            xor ^= freq[i];
        }
        return xor == 0;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        int s = 122233;
        System.out.println(check(s) ? "Yes" : "No");
    }
}
```

```java
import java.util.Arrays;

public class PartitionCalculator {
    public static int partitions(int n) {
        int[] p = new int[n + 1];
        Arrays.fill(p, 0);
        p[0] = 1;

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            int k = 1;
            while ((k * (3 * k - 1)) / 2 <= i) {
                p[i] += ((k % 2 != 0 ? 1 : -1) * p[i - (k * (3 * k - 1)) / 2]);
                if (k > 0) k *= -1; else k = 1 - k;
            }
        }
        return p[n];
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        int N = 20;
        System.out.println(partitions(N));
    }
}
```

import java.util.Arrays;

public class PartitionCalculator {
    public static int partitions(int n) {
        int[] p = new int[n + 1];
        Arrays.fill(p, 0);
        p[0] = 1;

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            int k = 1;
            while ((k * (3 * k - 1)) / 2 <= i) {
                p[i] += ((k % 2 != 0 ? 1 : -1) * p[i - (k * (3 * k - 1)) / 2]);
                if (k > 0) k *= -1; else k = 1 - k;
            }
        }
        return p[n];
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        int N = 20;
        System.out.println(partitions(N));
    }
}

```java
public class PathCounter {
    public static int countPaths(int n, int m) {
        if (n == 0 && m == 0) 
            return 1; 
        return (countPaths(n - 1, m) + countPaths(n, m - 1)); 
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        int n = 3; 
        int m = 2; 
        System.out.println("Number of Paths " + countPaths(n, m)); 
    }
}
```

```java
public class PathCounter {
    public static int countPaths(int n, int m) {
        if (n == 0 && m == 0) {
            return 1;
        }
        return (countPaths(n - 1, m) + countPaths(n, m - 1));
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        int n = 3;
        int m = 2;
        System.out.println("Number of Paths " + countPaths(n, m));
    }
}
```

```java
public class PathCounter {
    public static int countPaths(int n, int m) {
        if (n == 0 && m == 0) {
            return 1;
        }
        return (countPaths(n - 1, m) + countPaths(n, m - 1));
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        int n = 3;
        int m = 2;
        System.out.println("Number of Paths " + countPaths(n, m));
    }
}
```

public class PathCounter {
    public static int countPaths(int n, int m) {
        if (n == 0 && m == 0) {
            return 1;
        }
        return (countPaths(n - 1, m) + countPaths(n, m - 1));
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {

```java
public class GoldMine {
    public static int getMaxGold(int[][] gold, int m, int n) {
        final int MAX = 100;
        int[][] goldTable = new int[m][n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++)
                goldTable[i][j] = 0;

        for (int col = n - 1; col >= 0; col--) {
            for (int row = 0; row < m; row++) {
                int right, right_up, right_down;

                if (col == n - 1)
                    right = 0;
                else
                    right = goldTable[row][col + 1];

                if (row == 0 || col == n - 1)
                    right_up = 0;
                else
                    right_up = goldTable[row - 1][col + 1];

                if (row == m - 1 || col == n - 1)
                    right_down = 0;
                else
                    right_down = goldTable[row + 1][col + 1];

                goldTable[row][col] = gold[row][col] + Math.max(right, Math.max(right_up, right_down));
            }
        }

        int res = goldTable[0][0];
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++)
            res = Math.max(res, goldTable[i][0]);

        return res;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        int[][] gold = {
            {1, 3, 1, 5},
            {2, 2, 4, 1},
            {5, 0, 2, 3},
            {0, 6, 1, 2}
        };
        int m = 4;
        int n = 4;
        System.out.println(getMaxGold(gold, m, n));
    }
}
```

```python
import collections

class GFG:
    @staticmethod
    def min_sum(A, N):
        mp = {}
        sum = 0
        for i in range(N):
            sum += A[i]
            if A[i] in mp:
                mp[A[i]] += 1
            else:
                mp[A[i]] = 1
        
        min_sum = float('inf')
        for key, value in mp.items():
            min_sum = min(min_sum, sum - (key * value))
```

```python
    def prime(self, n):
        if n == 1:
            return False
        for i in range(2, int(n**0.5) + 1):
            if n % i == 0:
                return False
        return True

        else:
```

```python
import itertools

Landau = float('-inf')

def gcd(a, b):
    if a == 0:
        return b
    return gcd(b % a, a)

def lcm(a, b):
    return (a * b) // gcd(a, b)

def find_lcm(arr):
    nth_lcm = arr[0]
    for i in range(1, len(arr)):
        nth_lcm = lcm(nth_lcm, arr[i])
    global Landau
    Landau = max(Landau, nth_lcm)

def find_ways(arr, i, n):
    if n == 0:
        find_lcm(arr)
    for j in range(i, n + 1):
        arr.append(j)
        find_ways(arr, j, n - j)
        arr.pop()

def landau_function(n):
    arr = []
    find_ways(arr, 1, n)
    print(Landau)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    N = 4
    landau_function(N)
```

```java
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.Map;

public class Main {
    public static int minSum(int[] A, int N) {
        Map<Integer, Integer> mp = new HashMap<>();
        int sum = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            sum += A[i];
            if (mp.containsKey(A[i])) {
                mp.put(A[i], mp.get(A[i]) + 1);
            } else {
                mp.put(A[i], 1);
            }
        }
        int minSum = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
        for (int it : mp.keySet()) {
            minSum = Math.min(minSum, sum - (it * mp.get(it)));
        }
        return minSum;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        int[] arr = {4, 5, 6, 6};
        int N = arr.length;
        System.out.println(minSum(arr, N));
    }
}
```

    public static int minSum(int[] A, int N) {

```java
        List<Integer> res = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 1; i < N - 1; i++) {

        System.out.println();
    }
```

```java
import java.util.*;

class PrimeCalculator {
    boolean prime(int n) {
        if (n == 1) {
            return false;
        }
        for (int i = 2; i <= n; i++) {
            if (i * i > n) {
                break;
            }
            if (n % i == 0) {
                return false;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }

    void minDivisor(int n) {
        if (prime(n)) {
            System.out.println(1 + " " + (n - 1));
        } else {
            for (int i = 2; i <= n; i++) {
                if (i * i > n) {
                    break;
                }
                if (n % i == 0) {
                    System.out.println(n / i + " " + (n / i * (i - 1)));
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        int N = 4;
        PrimeCalculator calculator = new PrimeCalculator();
        calculator.minDivisor(N);
    }
}
```

```java
import java.lang.System;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

public class Main {
    long Landau = Long.MIN_VALUE;

    public static int gcd(int a, int b) {
        if (a == 0) {
            return b;
        }
        return gcd(b % a, a);
    }

    public static int lcm(int a, int b) {
        return (a * b) / gcd(a, b);
    }

    public static void findLCM(List<Integer> arr) {
        Landau = Long.MIN_VALUE;
        int nth_lcm = arr.get(0);
        for (int i = 1; i < arr.size(); i++) {
            nth_lcm = lcm(nth_lcm, arr.get(i));
        }
        Landau = Math.max(Landau, nth_lcm);
    }

    public static void findWays(List<Integer> arr, int i, int n) {
        if (n == 0) {
            findLCM(arr);
        }
        for (int j = i; j <= n; j++) {
            arr.add(j);
            findWays(arr, j, n - j);
            arr.remove(arr.size() - 1);
        }
    }

    public static void Landau_function(int n) {
        List<Integer> arr = new ArrayList<>();
        findWays(arr, 1, n);
        System.out.println(Landau);
    }

        Landau_function(N);
    }
```

```java
import java.lang.Math;

public static int func(int[] arr, int n) {
    int ans = 0;
    int maxx = 0;
    int[] freq = new int[100005];
    int temp = 0;
    
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        temp = arr[i];
        freq[temp]++;
        maxx = Math.max(maxx, temp);
    }
    
    for (int i = 1; i <= maxx; i++) {
        freq[i] += freq[i - 1];
    }
    
    for (int i = 1; i <= maxx; i++) {
        if (freq[i] != 0) {
            int value = 0;

            double j = 1.5;

                }
                j += 1;
            }
```

```java
import java.lang.Math;

public static int func(int[] arr, int n) {
    int ans = 0;
    int maxx = 0;
    int[] freq = new int[100005];
    int temp = 0;

    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        temp = arr[i];
        freq[temp]++;
        maxx = Math.max(maxx, temp);
    }

    for (int i = 1; i <= maxx; i++) {
        freq[i] += freq[i - 1];
    }

    for (int i = 1; i <= maxx; i++) {
        if (freq[i] != 0) {
            int value = 0;
```

```javascript
        let mp = new Map();
        let sum = 0;

            sum += A[i];
```

```java
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.Map;

public class Main {
    public static int minSum(int[] A, int N) {
        Map<Integer, Integer> mp = new HashMap<>();
        int sum = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            sum += A[i];
            mp.put(A[i], mp.getOrDefault(A[i], 0) + 1);
        }
        int minSum = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
        for (Map.Entry<Integer, Integer> it : mp.entrySet()) {
            minSum = Math.min(minSum, sum - (it.getKey() * it.getValue()));
        }
        return minSum;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        int[] arr = {4, 5, 6, 6};
        int N = arr.length;
        System.out.print(minSum(arr, N) + " ");
    }
}
```

import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.Map;

public class Main {
    public static int minSum(int[] A, int N) {
        Map<Integer, Integer> mp = new HashMap<>();
        int sum = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            sum += A[i];
            mp.put(A[i], mp.getOrDefault(A[i], 0) + 1);
        }
        int minSum = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
        for (Map.Entry<Integer, Integer> it : mp.entrySet()) {
            minSum = Math.min(minSum, sum - (it.getKey() * it.getValue()));
        }
        return minSum;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        int[] arr = {4, 5, 6, 6};
        int N = arr.length;
        System.out.print(minSum(arr, N) + " ");
    }
}

```java
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

public class Main {
    public static void maxAdjacent(int[] arr, int N) {
        List<Integer> res = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 1; i < N - 1; i++) {
            int prev = arr[0];
            int maxi = Integer.MIN_VALUE;
            for (int j = 1; j < N; j++) {
                if (i == j) continue;
                maxi = Math.max(maxi, Math.abs(arr[j] - prev));
                prev = arr[j];
            }
            res.add(maxi);
        }
        for (int j = 0; j < res.size(); j++) {
            System.out.print(res.get(j) + " ");
        }
        System.out.print(" ");
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        int[] arr = {1, 3, 4, 7, 8};
        int N = arr.length;
        maxAdjacent(arr, N);
    }
}
```

```java
public class CountOnesCalculator {

    // Function to find the size based on the given N
    public static int findSize(int N) {
        if (N == 0) return 1;
        if (N == 1) return 1;
        int Size = 2 * findSize((int) Math.floor(N / 2)) + 1;
        return Size;
    }

    // Function to count ones between L and R for the given N
    public static int CountOnes(int N, int L, int R) {
        if (L > R) {
            return 0;
        }
        if (N <= 1) {
            return N;
        }
        int ret = 0;
        int M = (int) Math.floor(N / 2);
        int Siz_M = findSize(M);
        
        if (L <= Siz_M) {
            ret += CountOnes((int) Math.floor(N / 2), L, Math.min(Siz_M, R));
        }
        if (L <= Siz_M + 1 && Siz_M + 1 <= R) {
            ret += N % 2;
        }
        if (Siz_M + 1 < R) {
            ret += CountOnes((int) Math.floor(N / 2), Math.max(1, L - Siz_M - 1), R - Siz_M - 1);
        }
        return ret;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        int N = 7, L = 2, R = 5;
        System.out.println(CountOnes(N, L, R));
    }
```

public class CountOnesCalculator {

    // Function to find the size based on the given N
    public static int findSize(int N) {
        if (N == 0) return 1;
        if (N == 1) return 1;
        int Size = 2 * findSize((int) Math.floor(N / 2)) + 1;
        return Size;
    }

    // Function to count ones between L and R for the given N
    public static int CountOnes(int N, int L, int R) {
        if (L > R) {
            return 0;
        }
        if (N <= 1) {
            return N;
        }
        int ret = 0;
        int M = (int) Math.floor(N / 2);
        int Siz_M = findSize(M);
        
        if (L <= Siz_M) {
            ret += CountOnes((int) Math.floor(N / 2), L, Math.min(Siz_M, R));
        }
        if (L <= Siz_M + 1 && Siz_M + 1 <= R) {
            ret += N % 2;
        }
        if (Siz_M + 1 < R) {
            ret += CountOnes((int) Math.floor(N / 2), Math.max(1, L - Siz_M - 1), R - Siz_M - 1);
        }
        return ret;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        int N = 7, L = 2, R = 5;
        System.out.println(CountOnes(N, L, R));
    }
}

```java
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

public class Main {
    static long Landau = -1000000000;

    public static int gcd(int a, int b) {
        if (a == 0) return b;
        return gcd(b % a, a);
    }

    public static int lcm(int a, int b) {
        return (a * b) / gcd(a, b);
    }

    public static void findLCM(List<Integer> arr) {
        int nth_lcm = arr.get(0);
        for (int i = 1; i < arr.size(); i++) {
            nth_lcm = lcm(nth_lcm, arr.get(i));
        }
        Landau = Math.max(Landau, nth_lcm);
    }

    public static void findWays(List<Integer> arr, int i, int n) {
        if (n == 0) findLCM(arr);
        for (int j = i; j <= n; j++) {
            arr.add(j);
            findWays(arr, j, n - j);
            arr.remove(arr.size() - 1);
        }
    }

    public static void Landau_function(int n) {
        List<Integer> arr = new ArrayList<>();
        findWays(arr, 1, n);
        System.out.println(Landau);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        int N = 4;
        Landau_function(N);
    }
}
```

```java
public class PrimeChecker {

    // Method to check if a number is prime
    public static boolean isPrime(int n) {
        // Handle edge cases
        if (n == 1) return true; // 1 is considered prime for this implementation
        if (n <= 3) return true; // 2 and 3 are prime numbers
        if (n % 2 == 0 || n % 3 == 0) return false; // Eliminate multiples of 2 and 3

        // Check for factors from 5 to sqrt(n)
        for (int i = 5; i * i <= n; i += 6) {
            if (n % i == 0 || n % (i + 2) == 0) return false; // Check divisibility
        }
        return true; // n is prime
    }

    // Method to check the expression and print output
    public static void checkExpression(int n) {
        if (isPrime(n)) {
            System.out.print(" "); // Output for prime
        } else {
            System.out.print(" "); // Output for non-prime
        }
    }

    // Main method to execute the program
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        int N = 3; // Declare and initialize N
        checkExpression(N); // Call the checkExpression method
    }
}
```

```java
public class Main {
    public static int func(int[] arr, int n) {
        int ans = 0;
        int maxx = 0;
        int[] freq = new int[100005];
        int temp;
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            temp = arr[i];
            freq[temp]++;
            maxx = Math.max(maxx, temp);
        }
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= maxx; i++) {
            freq[i] += freq[i - 1];
        }
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= maxx; i++) {
            if (freq[i] != 0) {

                    ans += times * con * (freq[val] - freq[(int)cur]);
                    cur = val;
                    if (val == maxx) break;
                }
            }
        }
        return ans;
    }
```

            temp = arr[i];
            freq[temp]++;
            maxx = Math.max(maxx, temp);
        }
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= maxx; i++) {
            freq[i] += freq[i - 1];
        }
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= maxx; i++) {
            if (freq[i] != 0) {
                double j;
                double cur = Math.ceil(0.5 * i) - 1;
                for (j = 1.5; ; j++) {
                    int val = Math.min(maxx, (int)(Math.ceil(i * j) - 1));
                    int times = (freq[i] - freq[i - 1]);
                    double con = (j - 0.5);
                    ans += times * con * (freq[val] - freq[(int)cur]);
                    cur = val;
                    if (val == maxx) break;
                }
            }
        }
        return ans;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        int[] arr = new int[]{1, 2, 3};
        int n = arr.length;
        System.out.println(func(arr, n));
    }
}
